title: Kleo: one chat message, one finished video

direction.subject: What Kleo does: a person asks for a video in a chat and gets a finished 4K Short back in the same chat
direction.goal: The viewer understands that one URL and one plain-words request in Claude or ChatGPT produce a finished Short
direction.audience: creators and founders new to Kleo who want videos without editing
direction.tone: calm, cinematic and factual, like a product trailer
must_keep: connect it to Claude or ChatGPT with one URL
ask for a video in plain words
get a 4K Short with narration and captions back in the same chat
direction.world: A quiet home studio at dusk: a wooden desk by a tall window, a laptop and a phone, a warm desk lamp against cool blue evening light, shallow depth of field, cinematic photograph

cast.name: the creator
cast.look: a woman in her thirties with short dark hair, plain charcoal sweater, calm focused expression, no glasses, no jewellery

scenes.voice: One chat message. That is the whole job. Watch someone ask for a video and get it back.
